main: This section defines the passive electrical properties of the membrane, which apply uniformly to all parts of the neuron unless overridden by another distribution rule.

fields.path: The morphological path where these passive properties will be applied. Use 'soma', 'dend', 'axon', or a specific path like '/cell/dend[0]'. Typically, a single entry with path 'soma' is used to set global properties.
fields.leakReversalPotential: Leak reversal potential (Em). Enter a number in mV, or a muParser expression in V. Allowed variables: p (path dist from soma, m), g (geometric dist, m), L (electrotonic dist, λ), len (compartment length, m), dia (compartment diameter, m), maxP, maxG, maxL.
fields.initialPotential: Initial membrane potential (initVm). Enter a number in mV, or a muParser expression in V. Allowed variables: p, g, L, len, dia, maxP, maxG, maxL. Usually the same value as Em.
fields.membraneCapacitance: Specific membrane capacitance (CM), in F/m^2. May be a number or a muParser expression using: p, g, L, len, dia, maxP, maxG, maxL.
fields.membraneResistivity: Specific membrane resistance (RM), in Ohm.m^2. May be a number or a muParser expression using: p, g, L, len, dia, maxP, maxG, maxL.
fields.axialResistivity: Specific axial resistivity (RA), in Ohm.m. May be a number or a muParser expression using: p, g, L, len, dia, maxP, maxG, maxL.
